verses.original: Διὸ ἀφέντες τὸν τῆς ἀρχῆς τοῦ Χριστοῦ λόγον ἐπὶ τὴν τελειότητα φερώμεθα μὴ πάλιν θεμέλιον καταβαλλόμενοι μετανοίας ἀπὸ νεκρῶν ἔργων καὶ πίστεως ἐπὶ Θεόν
verses.transliteration: Dio aphentes ton tēs archēs tou Christou logon epi tēn teleiotēta pherōmetha mē palin themelion kataballomenoi metanoias apo nekrōn ergōn kai pisteōs epi Theon
verses.literal: Therefore let us leave the elementary teachings about Christ and go on to maturity not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works and of faith in God
verses.literalPt: POR isso, deixando os rudimentos da doutrina de Cristo, prossigamos até à perfeição, não lançando de novo o fundamento do arrependimento de obras mortas e de fé em Deus,

verses.original: βαπτισμῶν διδαχὴν ἐπιθέσεώς τε χειρῶν ἀναστάσεώς τε νεκρῶν καὶ κρίματος αἰωνίου
verses.transliteration: baptismōn didachēn epitheseōs te cheirōn anastaseōs te nekrōn kai krimatos aiōniou
verses.literal: instruction about baptisms the laying on of hands the resurrection of the dead and eternal judgment
verses.literalPt: E da doutrina dos batismos, e da imposição das mãos, e da ressurreição dos mortos, e do juízo eterno.

verses.original: καὶ τοῦτο ποιήσομεν ἐάνπερ ἐπιτρέπῃ ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: kai touto poiēsomen eanper epitrepē ho Theos
verses.literal: And this we will do if God permits
verses.literalPt: E isto faremos, se Deus o permitir.

verses.original: Ἀδύνατον γὰρ τοὺς ἅπαξ φωτισθέντας γευσαμένους τε τῆς δωρεᾶς τῆς ἐπουρανίου καὶ μετόχους γενηθέντας Πνεύματος Ἁγίου
verses.transliteration: Adynaton gar tous hapax phōtisthentas geusamenous te tēs dōreas tēs epouraniou kai metochous genēthentas Pneumatos Hagiou
verses.literal: It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened who have tasted the heavenly gift who have shared . . . in the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: Porque é impossível que os que já uma vez foram iluminados, e provaram o dom celestial, e se tornaram participantes do Espírito Santo,

verses.original: καὶ καλὸν γευσαμένους Θεοῦ ῥῆμα δυνάμεις τε μέλλοντος αἰῶνος
verses.transliteration: kai kalon geusamenous Theou rhēma dynameis te mellontos aiōnos
verses.literal: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age
verses.literalPt: E provaram a boa palavra de Deus, e as virtudes do século futuro,

verses.original: καὶ παραπεσόντας πάλιν ἀνακαινίζειν εἰς μετάνοιαν ἀνασταυροῦντας ἑαυτοῖς τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ παραδειγματίζοντας
verses.transliteration: kai parapesontas palin anakainizein eis metanoian anastaurountas heautois ton Huion tou Theou kai paradeigmatizontas
verses.literal: and then have fallen away to be restored . . . to repentance because they themselves are crucifying the Son of God all over again and subjecting Him to open shame
verses.literalPt: E recaíram, sejam outra vez renovados para arrependimento; pois assim, quanto a eles, de novo crucificam o Filho de Deus, e o expõem ao vitupério.

verses.original: Γῆ γὰρ ἡ πιοῦσα τὸν ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ἐρχόμενον πολλάκις ὑετόν καὶ τίκτουσα βοτάνην εὔθετον ἐκείνοις δι’ οὓς καὶ γεωργεῖται μεταλαμβάνει εὐλογίας ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Gē gar hē piousa ton ep’ autēs erchomenon pollakis hyeton kai tiktousa botanēn eutheton ekeinois di’ hous kai geōrgeitai metalambanei eulogias apo tou Theou
verses.literal: For land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is tended receives the blessing of God
verses.literalPt: Porque a terra que embebe a chuva, que muitas vezes cai sobre ela, e produz erva proveitosa para aqueles por quem é lavrada, recebe a bênção de Deus;

verses.original: ἐκφέρουσα δὲ ἀκάνθας καὶ τριβόλους ἀδόκιμος καὶ κατάρας ἐγγύς ἧς τὸ τέλος εἰς καῦσιν
verses.transliteration: ekpherousa de akanthas kai tribolous adokimos kai kataras engys hēs to telos eis kausin
verses.literal: But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless and its curse is imminent In the end it will be burned
verses.literalPt: Mas a que produz espinhos e abrolhos, é reprovada, e perto está da maldição; o seu fim é ser queimada.

verses.original: Πεπείσμεθα δὲ περὶ ὑμῶν ἀγαπητοί τὰ κρείσσονα καὶ ἐχόμενα σωτηρίας εἰ καὶ οὕτως λαλοῦμεν
verses.transliteration: Pepeismetha de peri hymōn agapētoi ta kreissona kai echomena sōtērias ei kai houtōs laloumen
verses.literal: Even though we speak like this beloved we are convinced of better things in your case things that accompany salvation
verses.literalPt: Mas de vós, ó amados, esperamos coisas melhores, e coisas que acompanham a salvação, ainda que assim falamos.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ἄδικος ὁ Θεὸς ἐπιλαθέσθαι τοῦ ἔργου ὑμῶν καὶ τῆς ἀγάπης ἧς ἐνεδείξασθε εἰς τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ διακονήσαντες τοῖς ἁγίοις καὶ διακονοῦντες
verses.transliteration: ou gar adikos ho Theos epilathesthai tou ergou hymōn kai tēs agapēs hēs enedeixasthe eis to onoma autou diakonēsantes tois hagiois kai diakonountes
verses.literal: For God is not unjust He will not forget your work and the love you have shown for His name as you have ministered to the saints and continue to do so
verses.literalPt: Porque Deus não é injusto para se esquecer da vossa obra, e do trabalho do amor que para com o seu nome mostrastes, enquanto servistes aos santos; e ainda servis.

verses.original: Ἐπιθυμοῦμεν δὲ ἕκαστον ὑμῶν τὴν αὐτὴν ἐνδείκνυσθαι σπουδὴν πρὸς τὴν πληροφορίαν τῆς ἐλπίδος ἄχρι τέλους
verses.transliteration: Epithymoumen de hekaston hymōn tēn autēn endeiknysthai spoudēn pros tēn plērophorian tēs elpidos achri telous
verses.literal: We want each of you to show this same diligence to the very end in order to make your hope sure
verses.literalPt: Mas desejamos que cada um de vós mostre o mesmo cuidado até ao fim, para completa certeza da esperança;

verses.original: ἵνα μὴ νωθροὶ γένησθε μιμηταὶ δὲ τῶν διὰ πίστεως καὶ μακροθυμίας κληρονομούντων τὰς ἐπαγγελίας
verses.transliteration: hina mē nōthroi genēsthe mimētai de tōn dia pisteōs kai makrothymias klēronomountōn tas epangelias
verses.literal: Then you will not be sluggish but will imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised
verses.literalPt: Para que vos não façais negligentes, mas sejais imitadores dos que pela fé e paciência herdam as promessas.

verses.original: Τῷ γὰρ Ἀβραὰμ ἐπαγγειλάμενος ὁ Θεός ἐπεὶ κατ’ οὐδενὸς εἶχεν μείζονος ὀμόσαι ὤμοσεν καθ’ ἑαυτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Tō gar Abraam epangeilamenos ho Theos epei kat’ oudenos eichen meizonos omosai ōmosen kath’ heautou
verses.literal: When God made His promise to Abraham since He had no one greater to swear by He swore by Himself
verses.literalPt: Porque, quando Deus fez a promessa a Abraão, como não tinha outro maior por quem jurasse, jurou por si mesmo,

verses.original: λέγων Εἰ μὴν εὐλογῶν εὐλογήσω σε καὶ πληθύνων πληθυνῶ σε
verses.transliteration: legōn Ei mēn eulogōn eulogēsō se kai plēthynōn plēthynō se
verses.literal: saying I will surely . . . bless you and multiply . . . your descendants
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Certamente, abençoando te abençoarei, e multiplicando te multiplicarei.

verses.original: καὶ οὕτως μακροθυμήσας ἐπέτυχεν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας
verses.transliteration: kai houtōs makrothymēsas epetychen tēs epangelias
verses.literal: And so Abraham after waiting patiently obtained the promise
verses.literalPt: E assim, esperando com paciência, alcançou a promessa.

verses.original: Ἄνθρωποι γὰρ κατὰ τοῦ μείζονος ὀμνύουσιν καὶ πάσης αὐτοῖς ἀντιλογίας πέρας εἰς βεβαίωσιν ὁ ὅρκος
verses.transliteration: Anthrōpoi gar kata tou meizonos omnyousin kai pasēs autois antilogias peras eis bebaiōsin ho horkos
verses.literal: Men swear by someone greater than themselves and their oath serves as a confirmation to end all argument
verses.literalPt: Porque os homens certamente juram por alguém superior a eles, e o juramento para confirmação é, para eles, o fim de toda a contenda.

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ περισσότερον βουλόμενος ὁ Θεὸς ἐπιδεῖξαι τοῖς κληρονόμοις τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τὸ ἀμετάθετον τῆς βουλῆς αὐτοῦ ἐμεσίτευσεν ὅρκῳ
verses.transliteration: en hō perissoteron boulomenos ho Theos epideixai tois klēronomois tēs epangelias to ametatheton tēs boulēs autou emesiteusen horkō
verses.literal: So when God wanted to make the unchanging nature of His purpose very clear to the heirs of the promise He guaranteed it with an oath
verses.literalPt: Por isso, querendo Deus mostrar mais abundantemente a imutabilidade do seu conselho aos herdeiros da promessa, se interpôs com juramento;

verses.original: ἵνα διὰ δύο πραγμάτων ἀμεταθέτων ἐν οἷς ἀδύνατον ψεύσασθαι τὸν Θεόν ἰσχυρὰν παράκλησιν ἔχωμεν οἱ καταφυγόντες κρατῆσαι τῆς προκειμένης ἐλπίδος
verses.transliteration: hina dia dyo pragmatōn ametathetōn en hois adynaton pseusasthai ton Theon ischyran paraklēsin echōmen hoi kataphygontes kratēsai tēs prokeimenēs elpidos
verses.literal: Thus by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie - we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged
verses.literalPt: Para que por duas coisas imutáveis, nas quais é impossível que Deus minta, tenhamos a firme consolação, nós, os que pomos o nosso refúgio em reter a esperança proposta;

verses.original: ἣν ὡς ἄγκυραν ἔχομεν τῆς ψυχῆς ἀσφαλῆ τε καὶ βεβαίαν καὶ εἰσερχομένην εἰς τὸ ἐσώτερον τοῦ καταπετάσματος
verses.transliteration: hēn hōs ankyran echomen tēs psychēs asphalē te kai bebaian kai eiserchomenēn eis to esōteron tou katapetasmatos
verses.literal: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul firm and secure It enters . . . the inner sanctuary behind the curtain
verses.literalPt: A qual temos como âncora da alma, segura e firme, e que penetra até ao interior do véu,

verses.original: ὅπου πρόδρομος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν εἰσῆλθεν Ἰησοῦς κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ ἀρχιερεὺς γενόμενος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: hopou prodromos hyper hēmōn eisēlthen Iēsous kata tēn taxin Melchisedek archiereus genomenos eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: where Jesus our forerunner has entered on our behalf He has become a high priest forever in the order of Melchizedek
verses.literalPt: Onde Jesus, nosso precursor, entrou por nós, feito eternamente sumo sacerdote, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
